rows.label: Core: 9 credits from the four introductory CRP courses
rows.note: Choose from Observing the City, Global Urban Studies, and the two methods courses (quantitative and qualitative); the credits total nine, which is three of these four courses.

rows.label: Electives: 9 credits of CRP courses at the 3000 level or above
rows.note: Any CRP course numbered 3000 or higher counts. Three courses are required here so the minor reaches six CRP courses in all (three core plus three electives).

rows.label: Check by hand: a C or better in every course counted toward the minor
rows.note: The board does not see grades.

rows.label: Check by hand: file the intent to minor form and the graduation application for the minor
rows.note: Forms go to the City and Regional Planning office; the graduation form is due at least a month before graduation.

rows.label: Check by hand: at least six courses in City and Regional Planning in all
rows.note: The core and elective rows already add up to six courses of 3 credits; confirm the count if any course carries unusual credits.
